policy.title: Car Rental Contract Terms & Policy
policy.intro: Please review our contract terms and rental policy before signing to ensure a smooth and transparent experience.

items.1: Valid National ID / Original passport for non-residents.
items.3: Recent utility bill, notarized lease, or ownership deed (copy) as proof of residence.
items.4: We do not serve renters under the legal age ( 26 years ).

items.1: Inspect the contracted vehicle, receive its keys and registration, and confirm the spare tire, jack, wheel spanner, and fire extinguisher are all in good condition.
items.2: A walk-around video is recorded at handover, and water & oil levels are checked.
items.3: A test drive is performed by the customer.

items.1: Day 1 ends at 12:00 AM (midnight) regardless of pickup time. Day 2 starts at 12:00 AM and ends at 12:00 AM the next day, and so on.
items.2: The renter is allowed 100 km per day. Any extra kilometer is charged at 6 EGP / 8 EGP / 10 EGP depending on the car's type and model.

items.1: A refundable deposit of 5,000 EGP is collected at contract signing (plus the original passport for non-residents). It is refunded at the end of the rental period, provided the car is returned in the same condition as received (fuel, exterior, interior, and cleaned).
The renter signs a declaration accepting full responsibility for any traffic violations during the rental period and agrees to settle them upon request.

policy.signature: With the regards of Al-Hossam Car Rental family
